limitation: Absolute endpoint change in the fitted models is a movement-magnitude proxy, not full-path realized volatility. These additional trade-path measures include microstructure noise and are not executable quote paths or guaranteed adverse-excursion costs.
semantics: Supplemental observed transaction-path diagnostics, not fitted model outcomes. Range, quadratic variation, path length and excursions use actual same-instrument trades and exact known-by/cursor boundaries; no interpolation or post-session invented prices.
